question_cn: G 组头名（小组第一出线）是哪支球队？
question_en: Which team finishes first in Group G?
one_liner_cn: 比利时凭明显的 Elo 实力差距最有可能拿下 G 组头名（约 65%），但核心球员伤病隐患让伊朗（约 24%）保留掀翻的空间。
one_liner_en: Belgium's clear Elo edge makes it the most likely Group G winner (~65%), but fitness doubts over its core leave Iran (~24%) genuine room for an upset.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 断层：比利时 1894（世界第 15）领先伊朗 1772、埃及 1696、新西兰 1562，纯 Elo 十万次模拟给出 67.7% 的头名基线。
key_reasons.en: Elo gap: Belgium 1894 (world #15) vs Iran 1772, Egypt 1696, New Zealand 1562 — the pure-Elo 100k-sim baseline puts Belgium at 67.7% to top the group.

key_reasons.cn: 比利时核心带伤：卢卡库本赛季因反复肌肉伤势几乎没踢正式比赛，德布劳内赛季末因眼伤缺阵，库尔图瓦刚走出伤病赛季——据此下调比利时 3pp。
key_reasons.en: Belgium's core is banged up: Lukaku has played barely an hour of competitive club football this season, De Bruyne was sidelined with an eye injury late in the season, and Courtois is off an injury-disrupted run — basis for the −3pp on Belgium.

key_reasons.cn: 挑战者阵容完整：伊朗 6/1 按期定名单、备战完整，是 6/21 直接对话的最大受益方（+1.5pp）；埃及由萨拉赫领衔、搭档马尔穆什，锋线质量高于其 Elo 排名（+1.5pp）。
key_reasons.en: Challengers intact: Iran named its final squad on schedule (Jun 1) and benefits most from the Jun 21 head-to-head (+1.5pp); Egypt, captained by Salah alongside Marmoush, carries more attacking quality than its Elo rank implies (+1.5pp).

method_note: Pure-Elo Poisson Monte Carlo, 100,000 full-tournament simulations (seed 20260611, eloratings.net snapshot 2026-06-11, no market input), plus bounded evidence-based adjustment capped at ±4pp/team: Belgium −3.0pp (core fitness risk), Iran +1.5pp, Egypt +1.5pp; deltas net to zero so the distribution sums to 1. Market-blind throughout.
